mil3.7.13:0.3: 13. The Question on the One’s Taste of the Ocean
mil3.7.13:1.2: “Sir Nagasena, for what reason does the ocean have one taste, a salty taste”?
mil3.7.13:1.3: “Because it has long stood still, Great King, the ocean of water has one taste, a salty taste”.
mil3.7.13:3.1: The Question on the One’s Taste of the Ocean, thirteenth.
